parameters.name: focalLength
parameters.label: Focal length
parameters.description: Of the whole system, with any reducer or Barlow you image through.

parameters.name: aperture
parameters.label: Aperture
parameters.description: The clear opening of the objective or mirror.

parameters.name: tubeDiameter
parameters.label: Tube outside diameter
parameters.description: Where the mask slides on: over the dew shield if there is one.

parameters.name: obstruction
parameters.label: Central obstruction
parameters.description: The secondary mirror's diameter on a reflector or SCT; left solid. 0 for a refractor.

parameters.name: factor
parameters.label: Bahtinov factor
parameters.description: The slit pitch is the focal length divided by this. 150 to 200 suits most scopes; lower makes a coarser grating.

parameters.name: angle
parameters.label: Side angle
parameters.description: How far the two side gratings are turned. 15 to 20° is usual; wider makes a wider X.

parameters.name: slitShare
parameters.label: Slit share
parameters.description: The share of each pitch that is open.

parameters.name: spineWidth
parameters.label: Spine
parameters.description: The solid bar between the two halves.

parameters.name: dividerWidth
parameters.label: Divider
parameters.description: The solid bar between the two side gratings.

parameters.name: collarDepth
parameters.label: Collar depth
parameters.description: 0 for a flat mask to cut on a laser or tape on.

parameters.name: clearance
parameters.label: Clearance
parameters.description: Added to the tube's radius. Raise it if a test print is tight; felt on the inside takes up a loose one.

parameters.name: color
parameters.label: Colour
parameters.description: Print in black or another opaque colour.
